title: Valence Bond Theory in complexes
basic_overview: VBT uses hybridisation and pairing assumptions to rationalise coordination geometry and magnetism.

extra_info_content.short_trick: VBT predicts geometry; CFT explains splitting/CFSE better.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. d count. 2. Ligand strength/pairing assumption. 3. Hybridisation. 4. Geometry. 5. Unpaired electrons.
extra_info_content.factors: VBT has important limitations for spectra and quantitative stability.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
